content: A time interval StbMTimerStartThreshold ( ECUC_StbM_00063 : ) before a Customer Timer expires, the StbM shall calculate the time difference between CustomerTimerExpireTime and the curren t value of the corresponding Time Base. The StbM shall then start a GPT timer ( ECUC_StbM_00039 : ) via Gpt_StartTimer() to be notified, when the time difference has elapsed .
